state_references.label: Bank11_Data_172F7Bytes
state_references.text: ; Scene index TerrainRoomCursor selects an offset into three-byte animation/Y/X records. $FF skips to the next actor; a value below $10 terminates and becomes the scene handler selector. Initialize render and state flags before updating all actors.

state_references.label: UpdateActorHandlers_AfterHandler
state_references.text: ; 67 actor handler pointers: low bytes at $802C and high bytes at $806F in mapper bank six. ObjectHandler indexes both planes; dispatch pushes a synthetic next-slot return before jumping. The independently supported empty handler at $80B2 bounds the table.

animation_writers.label: Bank04_NextTerrainParticle
preceding: ; Each free actor receives animation $2A and independent offset/tick values; X is the allocated slot and Y remains the particle index.

animation_writers.label: Bank04_PlayCompletionActor
preceding: ; Run a scripted actor in slot eight through four consecutive animations ($6F..$73). Rise to the apex, then fall and alternate horizontal direction; animation completion restarts the next pose.

animation_writers.label: Bank05_NextSceneActor
preceding: ; Decode the next packed triple. Actor at list position $19 receives the horizontal flip bit; other actors use the normal scene orientation.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_WalkingBounceActor
preceding: ; A hit enters the shared reaction; otherwise initialize motion once, fall against terrain and walk by facing. Horizontal collision reverses the two-bit direction.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_FinishThrowCountdown
preceding: ; Count down the throw delay, then restore animation $14 and clear the local phase while retaining persistent high state bits.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_Actor8491Hit
preceding: ; Switch to animation $0F and enter the common hit reaction.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_ChooseActor8491Pose
preceding: ; At animation frame twelve choose pose $0D or $0E from the random accumulator; pose $0E queues sound $2A. Reset animation timing for the new pose.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_TerrainObjectSlidePose
preceding: ; Select animation $20, fall and slide until terrain or actor contact chooses a reaction.

animation_writers.label: ActorBeginRemovalEffect
preceding: ; Replace the actor animation, disable its ordinary handler/collision profile and request a sound. The render flags retain visibility/facing while selecting a terminal animation mode.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_RevealRecoveredAnimation
preceding: ; Wait for the reaction animation to reach frame/tick gate, restore its saved animation and apply the option-dependent rule before restarting animation timing.

animation_writers.label: ActorSaveAnimationForReaction
preceding: ; Stop vertical motion, save the previous animation and switch to the common reaction animation before advancing state.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_AdjustStageOneContactProfile
preceding: ; Outside the player swing pose select animation $5B and profile $82 or $83 according to vertical distance. This is a contact-shape choice, not proof of a specific character identity.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_Actor9313StartMotion
preceding: ; Enter the movement pose, set profile bit seven and advance state after the held animation frame.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_PairedActorController
preceding: ; Maintain a linked actor slot. A hit or linked handler nine triggers a sixty-tick reaction, while ordinary updates alternate walking and waiting poses and change the companion animation/flip.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_AmbushAttackTransition
preceding: ; Close horizontal proximity starts animation $3C, upward velocity and sound $1F. The following fall lands into a protected $78-tick rest pose before the cycle resumes.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_EndAmbushRest
preceding: ; On rest expiry restore animation $3B, local phase two and the ordinary collision profile.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_Actor9B10Landing
preceding: ; Restore animation $55 on contact, reset its timing, adjust Y and return two local phases toward the patrol state.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_PushingContactActor
preceding: ; After the hit/visibility gate, wait for ground support and player proximity. Walk until terrain/actor contact, then save an affected slot and play a pushing animation before launching that target.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_ActorA065ResetApproach
preceding: ; A facing change advances state and restores animation $4C with equal vertical/horizontal speeds $01CC.

animation_writers.label: Bank06_InitializeFinalBossOverride
preceding: ; Complete the late-stage spawn override by clearing collision, preserving persistent state with bit four and selecting animation $84. Handler $3A and shared HP five were installed by the preceding progression gate.

animation_writers.label: PositionLandSelection
preceding: ; Set the current stage, cursor/selection actor coordinates and stage-name animation selectors. Read directional edges to select the adjacent stage.

animation_writers.label: PositionLandSelection
preceding: ; Set the current stage, cursor/selection actor coordinates and stage-name animation selectors. Read directional edges to select the adjacent stage.

animation_writers.label: LandSelectLoopAndConfirm
preceding: ; Update selection actors and sound, compose/yield each frame and confirm with A. Confirmation fades out, clears display/actors, rebuilds stage layout, writes stage UI and loads that stage's CHR list.

animation_writers.label: LandSelectLoopAndConfirm
preceding: ; Update selection actors and sound, compose/yield each frame and confirm with A. Confirmation fades out, clears display/actors, rebuilds stage layout, writes stage UI and loads that stage's CHR list.

animation_writers.label: InitializeSpecialRoomActorRecord
preceding: ; Records provide animation, world X low/high, Y, handler and profile. Initialize every other actor slot, leaving intermediate slots available; a negative animation terminates the list.

animation_writers.label: PlayerCrouchOrWalk
preceding: ; Held DOWN selects the crouched animation and restart frame. Other directional input invokes horizontal movement and then selects the walking response.

animation_writers.label: PlayerMomentumAnimationDelay_Continue_E46D
preceding: ; Reset the walking delay and select animation one, clearing animation frame/tick only when the selector changes.

animation_writers.label: PlayerLandOrPogo
preceding: ; Pogo sets upward velocity 05A8, animation six and player state two with a sound. Ordinary landing selects animation eight and returns to standing state, then performs horizontal motion.

animation_writers.label: PlayerLeaveSpecialAnimation
preceding: ; If the qualifying animation loses contact, replace it with airborne animation two and reset its frame/tick.

animation_writers.label: SelectPlayerAirborneAnimation
preceding: ; Choose ordinary airborne animation two or pogo animation six, resetting frame/tick only as required by the selector change.

animation_writers.label: PlayerSnowLikePose
preceding: ; Select animation 2C, step Y downward by four and permit A to enter the normal jump path. This is probably the snow interaction seen in Himalayas; the exact association between this pose and named terrain artwork remains tentative.

animation_writers.label: UpdatePlayerDeathTrajectory
preceding: ; Initialize an upward arc and half-pixel positive-X speed once. At the apex clear vertical velocity, then fall until Y=$E0 triggers the common life-loss reload.

animation_writers.label: DialogueRevealActor
preceding: ; Reinitialize the saved actor as animation $1B/handler eight, remove two collision-cache cells and start the changed-terrain burst.

animation_writers.label: ApplyOptionRewardAnimation
preceding: ; For the applicable title option, remap reward animations $25/$26 to $28/$24. Other animations remain unchanged.
